name: Science Explorers: Body, Earth & Space
description: For learners and classrooms: fun, curriculum-friendly science about the human body, our planet, and space - great for class review games.

questions.prompt: Which organ pumps blood around the body?
questions.explanation: The heart pumps blood to every part of the body.

questions.prompt: What gas do plants absorb for photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: Plants take in carbon dioxide and release oxygen.

questions.prompt: How many planets are in our solar system?
questions.explanation: There are 8 planets; Pluto is classified as a dwarf planet.
Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system.

questions.prompt: What force pulls objects toward Earth?
questions.explanation: Gravity pulls objects toward the center of the Earth.

questions.prompt: Which part of the plant makes food?
questions.explanation: Leaves use sunlight to make food for the plant.

questions.prompt: At what temperature Celsius does water boil at sea level?
questions.explanation: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
Red blood cells carry oxygen using hemoglobin.

questions.prompt: What causes day and night on Earth?
questions.explanation: Earth spins on its axis, so different sides face the Sun.
Solar energy is naturally replenished and renewable.

questions.prompt: How many bones are in the adult human body?
questions.explanation: Adults have 206 bones; babies are born with about 300.

questions.prompt: Which layer of Earth do we live on?
questions.explanation: We live on the crust, the thin outer layer of Earth.

questions.prompt: What do we call animals that eat only plants?
Why does the Moon shine at night?
questions.explanation: The Moon reflects light from the Sun.
